angle.hook: a sci-fi shooter set in a ruined Seoul opens sign-ups for its first alpha, but only eight non-Arab countries qualify
angle.why_now: NC and BigFire Games posted the alpha playtest sign-ups on Steam on 12 Nov 2026
angle.what_it_means_here: No Gulf or Arab country is on the eligible list, so Gulf players cannot sign up for this alpha
angle.payoff: the dates (4 to 6 Dec PST, sign-ups to 30 Nov) and the country list
